Sinking Funds Bucket Manager

Keep one real bank balance, with separate virtual balances for Pets, Holidays/Gifts, Car Maintenance, Disney+, and Kids.

How bucket balances work Your real account balance is still controlled by the Accounts and Expense Tracker sections. Deposits, transfers, and spending must be recorded there first. Then use Allocate or Release below to update the virtual breakdown. These bucket actions do not create bank transactions or change account balances. The unallocated amount automatically reconciles the buckets to the real account balance.

Backup & Restore

Backup & Transfer Between Devices

Move your FinHub data between your laptop, phone, or tablet using a backup file. Save the exported file somewhere both devices can access, such as Google Drive or iCloud.

Quick separate backup: Ctrl+S / Cmd+S
Latest backup destinationNot selected yet

Choose where FinHub_LATEST_BACKUP.json lives. In supported browsers, FinHub can remember that file and ask permission to overwrite it on future backups. Otherwise, it downloads a fresh copy and you choose the save location in your browser.

No backup file connected.

No exported backup recorded yet
Backup reminder schedule Every 7 days

FinHub checks when the last JSON export was initiated and reminds you when a backup is due. The browser cannot silently save a backup file on a schedule, so use Export JSON Backup when reminded.

On-device safety copy

No local safety copy has been created yet.

A safety copy is stored in this browser before major deletions and imports. It is not a substitute for a downloaded JSON backup and will not follow you to another device.

Important: Importing replaces the data currently on this device; it does not merge two sets of changes. FinHub validates the file and shows a preview first. A local safety copy is created before replacement when browser storage allows it.

Custom Appearance

Automation Rules

Vendor Name Cleanup Rules

Turn bank descriptions such as “TIM HORTONS #0048 OTTAWA ON” into consistent vendor names.

Statement Import Rules

Automatically fill transaction type, vendor, category and debt-payment details when a bank description contains a saved phrase. Explicit CSV columns always take priority.

Categories & Subcategories

Expense Buckets & Subcategories

Used for spending, budgets and expense reporting.

Debt Categories & Subcategories

Used only when Type is Debt. Principal reduces the liability; interest is included in expense reporting.

Income Buckets & Subcategories

Used to classify money received. Kept separate from expense buckets.

Archived Accounts

Closed or retired accounts are hidden from active totals and selectors. Restore an account to use it again, or permanently delete it and its linked history.

Bulk Edit Transactions

Selected transactions

Only fields you change will be applied. Leave a field set to “No change” to preserve each transaction's current value.

Add Vendor Cleanup Rule

Rules match case-insensitively and ignore punctuation/spacing differences. Historical changes are previewed before applying. The original bank description remains available in statement reconciliation history.

Add Statement Import Rule

Rules apply only to imported rows whose original bank description contains the phrase. The rule does not change already-matched ledger transactions. Specific values in the CSV override rule defaults.

Statement Helper · Match & Reconcile

Choose an account, upload or paste a statement, then review the suggested matches before importing.

Upload a bank CSV or PDF statement, or paste statement data. PDF imports are reviewed before they enter your ledger.

For a single signed Amount column, FinHub uses the standard bank-account convention: positive = money in; negative = money out. Original bank descriptions are preserved, and saved import rules can fill in categories and other details.

Statement balance check · optional
Optionally enter the statement's opening and closing balances to compare the statement activity with FinHub.
Paste statement transactions · alternative to uploading a CSV

Copy rows directly from online banking or a spreadsheet. Comma- or tab-separated rows are supported.
